Description: pottery square also known a kumale tol is a renowned area in bhaktapur nepal where traditional potterymaking thrives visitor can observe artisan shaping clay into various item from household good like pot and jar to decorative souvenir such a animal and bird this square offer a unique opportunity to witness the traditional method of potterymaking with many potter using handpowered wheel or forming clay by hand

Name: Poudeldada
Description: poudeldada is a popular picnic spot located in chhagan gaun nepal situated approximately 44600 meter from the central area it offer a serene environment ideal for relaxation and outdoor activity

Name: Pragya Art Gallery
Description: pragya art gallery located in kathmandu nepal is a prominent art space dedicated to showcasing a diverse range of artwork the gallery serf a a platform for both emerging and established artist offering visitor an opportunity to experience the rich tapestry of nepalese art

Name: Pradhan Senapati Badabir Statue
Description: the pradhan senapati badabir statue is a monument located in shangakhara nepal it honor pradhan senapati badabir a distinguished military leader known for his contribution to nepal history the statue serf a a tribute to his legacy and is a point of interest for those exploring nepal historical site

Name: Pragya Thangka Art Gallery
Description: pragya thangka art gallery located in suryabinayak nepal is a renowned establishment specializing in traditional tibetan buddhist thangka painting these intricate artwork are meticulously crafted by skilled artisan offering visitor a deep insight into nepal rich cultural heritage

Name: Pujari Math
Description: pujari math located behind and to the right of the dattatraya temple in bhaktapur nepal is a historic structure renowned for it exquisite wood carving and rich cultural heritage constructed in the 15th century by king yaksha malla it originally served a a storage facility for donation and contribution over the century it ha undergone several reconstruction notably during king vishwa mallas reign in the mid16th century and wa renovated by the german government in the 20th centuryhighlights of pujari math architectural mastery the building is a fourstory structure with three inner courtyard each adorned with intricately carved window and door the most famous is the peacock window celebrated for it detailed craftsmanship wood carving museum the top floor house a museum showcasing a splendid collection of antique wood carving including a set of 14 roof strut image of vasundhara 1st century and tantric image of vishnu vishwa roop with 30 arm and 17 face cultural significance pujari math wa historically known for the production of herbal medicine attracting people from distant region seeking medical knowledge it also served a a residence for tibetan trader and priest reflecting the cultural exchange in the area

Name: Puranche Dolakha
Description: puranche dolakha is a historic site located in the dolakha district of nepal dolakha is renowned for it rich cultural heritage ancient monument and traditional newar architecture the district is home to several significant site including the dolakha bhimsen temple dedicated to bhimsen the patron god of trade and commerce

Name: Purna Museum of Newa Art
Description: the purna museum of newa art is a distinguished institution located in kupondole height lalitpur nepal established to preserve and showcase the rich heritage of newa art the museum feature an extensive collection of traditional newa painting sculpture and artifact this collection is the result of over four decade of dedication by it founder anjana and the late purna man shakya

Name: Purnachandi Mandir
Description: the purnachandi temple also known a siddhi laxmi temple is a significant hindu temple located approximately 500 meter west of patan durbar square in lalitpur nepal dedicated to the goddess purnachandi the temple is renowned for it rich history and architectural beautythe purnachandi temple is a threestory pagodastyle structure standing at the south end of a small teardrop shaped pond the first and second story are covered in copper while the third story is adorned with gold the temple intricate wood carving and detailed architecture reflect the artistic heritage of the newar community

Name: Pushpalal Memorial Park
Description: pushpalal memorial park is a wellmaintained public park located at p853x5j pushpalal path kathmandu 44600 nepal established in memory of comrade pushpalal shrestha a prominent figure in nepal communist movement the park offer a variety of experience for visitor

Name: RICH Museum of Craft and Design
Description: the rich museum of craft and design located at j8m9949 lalitpur 44700 nepal is a cultural hub dedicated to preserving and showcasing nepal rich artistic heritage housed in a traditional newarstyle house the museum offer visitor a glimpse into the intricate craftsmanship and design that define nepalese art

Name: RN Joshi Museum / Park Gallery
Description: the rn joshi museum park gallery situated in lalitpur nepal is dedicated to the work of the esteemed nepali artist rn joshi this cultural landmark offer a diverse collection of painting and sculpture that encapsulate nepal rich artistic heritagehe museum is housed in a traditional newastyle house providing an authentic ambiance that complement it artistic exhibit the surrounding park offer a serene environment for relaxation and contemplation visitor can explore the gallery engage with the artwork and enjoy the tranquil park setting

Name: Radha Krishna Trail
Description: the radha krishna trail is a scenic hiking route in nepal connecting the town of panauti to the namobuddha monastery this trail offer hiker a chance to experience the natural beauty and cultural heritage of the region

Name: Radhakrishna Temple
Description: the radhakrishna temple also known a the gopinath temple is a significant hindu temple located in bhaktapur durbar square nepal constructed in the 15th century during the reign of king yaksha malla it stand a one of the oldest temple in bhaktapur this pagodastyle temple is renowned for it intricate wood carving particularly on the door and window showcasing the exquisite craftsmanship of newar architecture the strut are adorned with image of various deity including incarnation of lord vishnu adding to the temple artistic and spiritual significance inside the temple visitor can find statue of lord krishna radha and balram each beautifully crafted and placed within the sanctum the temple is also distinguished by a stone pillar at it entrance topped with a garuda image and flanked by two stone lion enhancing it majestic appearance situated in the heart of bhaktapur durbar square the radhakrishna temple is an essential stop for those exploring the rich cultural and architectural heritage of the kathmandu valley

Name: Rainbow Thanka Gallery
Description: rainbow thanka gallery established in 1989 is a renowned art gallery located at 453 narsing chowk thamel kathmandu 44600 nepal specializing in traditional nepalese thangka painting the gallery offer a diverse collection of artwork that reflect the rich cultural heritage of nepal

Name: Raktakali Memorial Park
Description: raktakali memorial park located in nepal is a serene public space dedicated to the revered goddess raktakali a manifestation of goddess kali the park offer visitor a tranquil environment for relaxation and reflection complemented by it lush greenery and wellmaintained pathway adjacent to the park is the historic raktakali temple situated near naradevi in kathmandu this temple is one of nepal prominent shrine dedicated to goddess kali known locally a kulabhulu ajima the temple architecture and spiritual significance attract both devotee and tourist seeking to experience nepal rich cultural heritage

Name: Ram Mandir Battisputali
Description: ram mandir located in gaushala kathmandu is a prominent hindu temple dedicated to lord rama built by late jb rana the temple is renowned for it traditional nepali architecture featuring intricate design that reflect the region rich cultural heritage cultural significance the temple hold substantial importance for hindu devotee especially during festival like ram navami which celebrates the birth of lord rama during such occasion the temple becomes a focal point for religious activity and community gathering

Name: Ram Sita Mandir
Description: ram sita mandir located in panauti nepal is a revered hindu temple dedicated to lord rama and goddess sita panauti situated approximately 32 kilometer southeast of kathmandu is renowned for it rich cultural heritage and is often referred to a the town of 40 temple and 28 festival cultural significance the temple hold a special place in the heart of devotee symbolizing the divine union of lord rama and goddess sita it is an integral part of panautis spiritual landscape contributing to the town reputation a an important cultural site in nepal architecture while specific architectural detail of ram sita mandir are limited panauti is known for it traditional newari architecture with temple featuring intricate wood carving and pagodastyle roof the town heritage structure reflect the craftsmanship and artistic excellence of the region

Name: Ramche Stone Park
Description: ramche stone park located in patlekhet kavrepalanchok district nepal is a picturesque destination known for it lush green field and serene surroundings visitor can immerse themselves in the natural beauty of the area making it an ideal spot for relaxation and sightseeing the park offer a tranquil environment perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat amidst nature

Name: Ramche Dada
Description: ramche dada situated in the rasuwa district of nepal is renowned for it scenic beauty and offer a rewarding hiking experience the trek to ramche dada typically begin from the town of dhunche ascending through lush forest and diverse landscape hiker are treated to panoramic view of the surrounding mountain including the majestic langtang range the journey culminates at ramche dada a vantage point that provides breathtaking vista of the himalaya this hike is ideal for nature enthusiast and trekker seeking a blend of adventure and tranquility for detailed itinerary and guidance resource like ghumante store offer valuable insight

Name: Rameshwor Temple
Description: rameshwor temple located in bhaktapur durbar square is a significant hindu shrine dedicated to lord shiva constructed during the malla era it feature an open structure supported by four intricately carved stone pillar with a roof resembling a backflipped lotus the temple house a shivalinga known a jalhari and is situated adjacent to the gopinath temple it design reflects the artistic excellence of king bhupatindra mallas reign visitor can observe the shivalinga from all side due to the temple open architecture this temple is part of the char dham pilgrimage circuit which includes four sacred site in india

Name: Rangi Art Gallery
Description: rangi art gallery situated on chaksibari marg in kathmandu nepal is a prominent venue dedicated to showcasing nepalese contemporary art the gallery collaborates with various artist each bringing their unique style and medium including oil watercolor and acrylic painting on highquality canvas and paper visitor can explore a diverse range of artwork from landscape and portrait to abstract piece rangi art gallery serf a a cultural hub offering art enthusiast an opportunity to engage with nepal rich artistic heritage

Name: Raniban Park
Description: raniban park also known a the queen forest is a serene retreat located in nagarjun municipality kathmandu situated approximately 35 kilometer from the fulbari gate the park encompasses the southern slope of nagarjun hill and offer a tranquil environment rich in natural beauty and historical significance visitor can explore ancient cave temple including the cave of buffalo buddha and enjoy panoramic view from jamacho peak the park dense forest and wellmaintained trail make it a popular destination for hiking and nature walk providing an escape from the city hustle and bustle

Name: Ranibari Community Forest
Description: ranibari community forest located in the northwestern part of kathmandu nepal span approximately 695 hectare and stand a one of the city few remaining natural forested area historically it served a a retreat for nepal royalty and house the porpa ajima temple reflecting it rich cultural heritage today the forest is a sanctuary for over 100 bird specie making it a favored spot for birdwatchers and nature enthusiast managed by the local community since it designation a a community forest on december 16 1999 it offer visitor serene walking trail amidst diverse flora and fauna providing a tranquil escape from urban life

Name: Ranipokhari of Bhaktapur
Description: ranipokhari also known a the queen pond is a historic artificial pond located in the heart of kathmandu nepal constructed in 1670 by king pratap malla in memory of his son the pond feature a central temple dedicated to lord shiva known a the balgopaleshwor temple the pond is surrounded by a stone wall adorned with statue of elephant symbolizing the king and his son ranipokhari hold significant cultural importance and is a popular site for religious ritual and festival including the annual chhath festival in 2015 the pond suffered damage due to an earthquake but reconstruction effort were completed in october 2020 restoring it historical and cultural significance in addition to it historical significance ranipokhari ha been a center for various cultural activity during the malla period it served a a venue for royal ceremony and public gathering the pond design with it central temple and surrounding statue reflects the architectural and artistic achievement of the era the restoration project aimed to preserve these element while ensuring the pond structural integrity for future generation today ranipokhari stand a a testament to nepal rich cultural heritage attracting both local and tourist who come to admire it beauty and historical significance the pond continues to be a site for various cultural event and religious ceremony maintaining it role a a central landmark in kathmandu

Name: Rapti Riverside
Description: rapti riverside located in hetauda nepal is a picturesque area along the east rapti river offering a serene environment for visitor the east rapti river flow from east to west through the chitwan valley forming the northern border of chitwan national park

Name: Rasuwagadhi Fort
Description: rasuwagadhi fort also known a rasuwa gadhi is a historical fortification located in the rasuwa district of nepal near the border with tibet china situated along the trishuli river approximately 3 kilometer north of the town of timure the fort offer visitor a glimpse into nepal rich history and strategic significance historical significance rasuwagadhi fort ha played a crucial role in nepal defense and trade route especially during the medieval period it strategic location near the tibet border made it a vital point for controlling access and monitoring movement between nepal and tibet the fort ruin today stand a a testament to it historical importance

Name: Ratan Khola Waterfall
Description: ratan khola waterfall located near chyamrangbesi in the besisahar area of nepal is a picturesque destination known for it natural beauty and serene environment the waterfall is situated along the ratan khola ratan river offering visitor a refreshing experience amidst lush greeneryto reach ratan khola waterfall visitor typically travel from besisahar the district headquarters of lamjung district from besisahar a short drive or hike lead to chyamrangbesi where the waterfall is located the journey offer scenic view of the surrounding landscape including the annapurna range

Name: Ratna Park
Description: ratna park situated in the heart of kathmandu nepal is a cherished green space that offer a tranquil retreat amidst the city vibrant atmosphere established in honor of queen ratna the wife of king mahendra the park serf a a central hub for both local and tourist seeking relaxation and leisure covering approximately 22000 square meter ratna park feature wellmaintained garden winding pathway and a central fountain creating a serene environment for visitor the park is adorned with lush garden winding pathway and a collection of native plant making it an ideal spot for relaxation or a leisurely stroll beyond it natural beauty ratna park is a vibrant social hub the surrounding area is lined with shop and food stall offering a variety of local snack and refreshment visitor can often find family enjoying picnic couple taking romantic walk or tourist simply resting on bench while soaking in the surroundings ratna park central location nestled between rani pokhari and tudikhel make it easily accessible and a popular destination for those looking to experience the hustle and bustle of kathmandu while enjoying a peaceful environment whether youre seeking a peaceful retreat a family outing or a picturesque location for photograph ratna park is a delightful destination that encapsulates the natural beauty and cultural heritage of nepal

Name: Ratnakar Mahabihar
Description: ratnakar mahabihar also known a ratnakar mahavihar is a significant buddhist monastery located in the heart of lalitpur patan nepal situated near the historic durbar square it stand a a testament to the rich cultural and religious heritage of the kathmandu valley historical significance constructed between the 16th and 17th century ratnakar mahabihar is one of the prominent bahals buddhist monastery in patan it ha preserved it traditional newar architecture featuring intricately carved wooden window door and facade reflecting the artistic excellence of the era visitor experience cultural hub the monastery serf a a center for religious activity meditation and education offering visitor a serene environment to immerse themselves in buddhist spirituality and culture architectural marvel visitor can admire the traditional newar architecture with it detailed woodwork and artistic design that showcase the craftsmanship of the period living goddess kumari ratnakar mahabihar is associated with the tradition of the living goddess known a the kumari the kumari resides in a magnificent intricately carved threefloored wooden and tile temple where she performs her daily ritual this temple known a the kumari chhen or kumari ghar is located on the southern end of basantapur durbar square nearby attraction patan durbar square a unesco world heritage site this historic square is home to numerous temple shrine and palace reflecting the architectural grandeur of the malla period mahabouddha temple known a the temple of a thousand buddha this temple is renowned for it unique terracotta architecture and intricate carving

Name: Rato Machchhindranath Jatra
Description: the rato machhindranath jatra is a significant and vibrant chariot festival held annually in patan nepal dedicated to machhindranath the rain god this festival is one of the oldest and most revered in the kathmandu valley festival highlight chariot processionthe festival feature a grand procession where a massive chariot constructed from bamboo and wood is pulled through the narrow street of patan by devotee this procession can last up to a month traversing various part of the city bhoto jatrathe festival culminates with the bhoto jatra a ceremony where a bejeweled vest bhoto is displayed to the public symbolizing the deity blessing cultural significance the rato machhindranath jatra is deeply rooted in the cultural and religious tradition of the kathmandu valley it is believed to have started in the 11th century and is considered a plea for generous rain a machhindranath is revered a the rain god visitor experience cultural immersion visitor can witness traditional ritual music and dance performance offering a deep insight into nepalese culture and religious practice photographythe vibrant procession intricate chariot design and enthusiastic participation provide excellent opportunity for photography enthusiast local cuisinethe festival area are lined with stall offering traditional nepali snack and beverage allowing visitor to savor local flavor best time to visit the rato machhindranath jatra typically take place in april or early may just before the monsoon season this timing is ideal for experiencing the festival grandeur and cultural richness

Name: Rato Machchhindranath Mandir
Description: the rato machchhindranath mandir is a significant religious site located in a large courtyard called ta baha about 400 meter south of patans lalitpurs darbar square this temple is dedicated to machhendranath also known a matsyendra a prominent yogi from the 10th century who considered the god shiva his teacher and practiced in the indic region of that era the current temple built in 1673 is situated on the foundation of earlier temple dating back to the 15th century it feature a towering newarstyle pagoda with three declining roof each covered in sheet metal possibly copper the structure is supported by 20 strut on the first and second level and 12 on the upper level each of the 52 strut is adorned with depiction of avalokitevara a bodhisattva shown in different pose with some of the figure featuring multiple set of arm at the lower register of the strut there are miniature scene illustrating scenario from buddhist hell such a people being boiled alive other vignette show more peaceful scene with deity supporting avalokitevara the northfacing side of the temple is decorated with an array of pot and pan mounted to table in a gravitydefying manner a typical feature of newar pagoda a long pataka strip hanging from the top of the temple to nearly ground level allows the deity to descend to earth during ritual adding to the temple spiritual significance and aweinspiring design

Name: Republic Memorial
Description: the republic memorial also known a ganatantra smarak is a significant landmark situated within the premise of the narayanhiti palace museum in kathmandu nepal this memorial commemorates the individual who contributed to the establishment of nepal a a republic marking the end of the monarchy location and significance located at narayanhiti palace museum the republic memorial stand a a tribute to those who played pivotal role in nepal transition to a republic the memorial feature a museum gallery with photographic exhibit chronicling nepal democratic movement during different period of history design and feature the memorial includes a booklike stone art installation symbolizing the federal republic constitution of nepal additionally the area contains an auditorium that serf a a gallery space with photograph and significant event carved on the wall providing visitor with a comprehensive understanding of nepal democratic journey visiting information the republic memorial is open to the public and offer a profound insight into nepal political history visitor can explore the exhibit and learn about the nation path to becoming a republic

Name: Reva Art Gallery
Description: reva art gallery located at m8gg3cc durbar square lalitpur 44600 nepal is a renowned art establishment offering a diverse range of artistic experience the gallery specializes in portrait charcoal oil painting and landscape in acrylic and oil medium

Name: Rincheling Thanka Gallery and Art School
Description: rincheling thangka gallery and art school situated on boudha road in kathmandu nepal is a renowned establishment dedicated to the creation and preservation of traditional tibetan thangka painting established in 1976 the school ha become a significant center for both the production and education of thangka art adhering to mahayana and vajrayana buddhist tradition visitor to rincheling thangka gallery can observe the meticulous process of thangka creation which involves intricate handpainting technique and the use of natural pigment the gallery offer a diverse collection of thangkas including depiction of deity mandala and scene from buddhist teaching these artwork serve a both spiritual tool for meditation and valuable cultural artifact the gallery also function a an art school providing instruction to aspiring artist in the traditional method of thangka painting under the guidance of experienced instructor student learn the philosophical and artistic principle underlying thangka art ensuring the continuation of this ancient craft

Name: Rock Edict (Chattahna Abhilekha)
Description: the rock edict known locally a chattahna abhilekha is a significant historical site located in the mahamanjushree nagar area of nepal this edict is part of the series of inscription commissioned by emperor ashoka of the maurya empire during his reign from 268 to 232 bce these inscription known a the edict of ashoka were carved on rock and pillar across the indian subcontinent including region of presentday nepal india bangladesh afghanistan and pakistan the edict primarily focus on moral and ethical guideline promoting value such a nonviolence tolerance and respect for all living being they also emphasize the importance of social welfare and the wellbeing of the populace the rock edict in mahamanjushree nagar is one of the many that reflect ashokas commitment to spreading the principle of dhamma righteousness throughout his empire visitor to the site can observe the ancient inscription which offer valuable insight into the historical and cultural context of the mauryan period the edict serf a a testament to ashokas effort in promoting ethical governance and social harmony exploring this site provides a unique opportunity to connect with nepal rich historical heritage and the broader narrative of ancient indian history

Name: Roshi Jharana
Description: roshi jharana also known a panchakanya jharana is a picturesque waterfall located near panauti in the kavrepalanchok district of nepal this serene spot is a popular destination for nature lover and traveler seeking a tranquil retreat location and accessibility situated approximately 20 kilometer southeast of kathmandu roshi jharana is easily accessible by road visitor can reach the site via a short drive from panauti followed by a brief walk through the lush greenery the area is wellmarked making it convenient for traveler to find attraction and activity the main attraction is the cascading waterfall which creates a natural pool at it base the cool clear water are inviting especially during the warmer month the surrounding area offer opportunity for picnic photography and relaxation amidst nature the tranquil environment make it an ideal spot for meditation and unwinding best time to visit the ideal time to visit roshi jharana is during the dry season from october to april when the weather is pleasant and the trail are accessible during the monsoon season the waterfall is at it fullest but the trail can be slippery so caution is advised nearby attraction while in the area visitor can explore the historic town of panauti known for it rich cultural heritage and ancient temple the confluence of the rosi and punyamati river in panauti is considered a sacred site and the town host the annual panauti jatra a vibrant festival celebrated with chariot procession and traditional dance visitor information there are no formal entry fee for visiting roshi jharana however it advisable to carry essential like water snack and a firstaid kit the area is relatively undeveloped so visitor should be prepared for basic facility it recommended to check local weather condition before planning your trip

Name: Royal Beach Camp
Description: royal beach camp situated along the trishuli river in khatauti khola dhading nepal is a premier ecoadventure destination offering a variety of outdoor activity established in 2006 the camp is strategically located approximately halfway between kathmandu pokhara and chitwan making it an accessible retreat for both local and tourist the camp provides a range of adventure sport including rafting canyoning and kayaking catering to both beginner and experienced enthusiast they offer weekend package that include rafting trip on the trishuli river with option for multiday expedition additionally the camp conduct kayaking course and familyfriendly adventure package ensuring a comprehensive experience for all visitor beyond adventure sport royal beach camp emphasizes ecotourism and community engagement they employ and train local youth enhancing their professional and social skill and contribute to the local economy by promoting sustainable tourism practice

Name: Ruby Valley
Description: ruby valley located in the dhading district of nepal is renowned for it natural beauty and cultural richness the valley is home to diverse ethnic community including tamang gurung and magar each with their unique tradition and lifestyle the area is also known for it rich biodiversity including endangered specie like the red panda while ruby valley is celebrated for it trekking route and scenic landscape it also ha a vibrant art scene local artist and gallery showcase traditional and contemporary nepali art offering visitor a chance to experience the region cultural heritage one such establishment is aita art gallery which feature watercolor landscape acrylic painting on canvas mandala art and sketch

Name: Rudrabarna Mahabihar (Uku Bahal)
Description: rudrabarna mahabihar also known a uku bahal is a historic buddhist monastery situated in patan nepal located south of patan durbar square this monastery is renowned for it wellpreserved newar buddhist architecture and rich cultural heritage historical significance the monastery wa established by king sivadev i of the lichhavi dynasty and ha been referenced in various ancient text it hold cultural and religious importance for the local newar community particularly the shakya clan who perform daily worship ritual here notably every male member of the shakya clan is required to serve a a priest at the bihar for at least two week once in his lifetime architectural feature rudrabarna mahabihar is distinguished by it exquisite architecture including a central courtyard adorned with a large white stupa four corner featuring statue of deity a spacious courtyard called tago chiba surrounded by row of house creating a communal atmosphere the monastery is also home to numerous metal artwork and intricately carved window reflecting the artistic prowess of the newar community visitor experience visitor to rudrabarna mahabihar can explore it serene courtyard observe traditional ritual and appreciate the intricate craftsmanship of the newar artisan the monastery offer a glimpse into the spiritual and cultural life of the local community a visit to rudrabarna mahabihar provides a profound insight into nepal buddhist heritage and the enduring tradition of the newar people

Description: heritage site within the sphere of dattatreya square there are three more temple that hold both cultural and religious paramount among them the salan ganesh temple is the one which lie in the righthand corner of the square a narrow street lead the way to the temple the temple is particularly special because of the image of lord ganesh but it is not a sculpture the image is rooted in a natural stone that ha a symbolic form of ganesha or the elephantheaded image nowadays it became more indistinguishable because of the red tika covered all over it the salan ganesh is also subtitled a the adhi ganesh among the asta ganesh during the procession process in gai jatra this temple is revolved by a bunch of people thus because of that it wa called salan ganesha however until today the exact erection date of the temple ha not been defined yet some guess call it the temple developed in the 13th century sumerialy the date 1654 also arouses a it erected date salan ganesha pokhari salan ganesh pokhari the pond behind the salan ganesha temple is said to be dedicated to the temple thatâ€™s why it is named the salan ganesha pokhari consequently the eve made this pond fill with young people a well a the old one while for now there is no use of this pond except for having a peaceful time with friend furthermore it is presumed that the pond might have been in existence since the 16 or 17th century from then till today this pond remains in it initial structure along with the length and width of 300 and 150 ft respectively nearby in the north direction of the pond there is an agam chhen of the respective temple the architecture is best known for it eccentric display of woodcarving all the torans window door a well a strut are shaped in beautiful pattern salan ganesh agam chhen pc praz santtbhaktapurcom

Name: Sauraha Tharu Village
